diagnosis: Squamous cell carcinoma, primary in parotid gland
legend: Tumour showing a salivary duct lined in part by (normal) respiratory epithelial cells transitioning to squamous cell carcinoma, the latter infiltrative (centre left). Note the area of squamous metaplasia of the duct epithelium (lower right).

diagnosis: Squamous cell carcinoma, primary in parotid gland
legend: Invasive keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma protruding into a salivary duct. Residual intact attenuated epithelial cells line the duct superior to the carcinoma.

diagnosis: Squamous cell carcinoma, primary in parotid gland
legend: Invasive squamous cell carcinoma comprising an admixture of well-, moderately, and poorly differentiated carcinoma.

diagnosis: Squamous cell carcinoma, primary in parotid gland
legend: The tumour includes a salivary duct lined in part by (normal) respiratory epithelial cells, with areas of squamous metaplasia, as well as a transition to squamous cell carcinoma. The squamous cell carcinoma is keratinizing and extensively invasive, with foci of well-, moderately, and poorly differentiated carcinoma.
